mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST declines by more than 10% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month industrial production growth acceleration above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity and higher corporate earnings, which lifts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO grows by more than 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines by more than 0.5% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP growth below 1% signals weakening macroeconomic demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 growth falls below 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
